entries.mem0ai/mem0: A universal memory layer and official Hermes Agent provider available as a managed cloud or self-hosted OSS. It features multi-level state management for users and sessions combined with time-aware hybrid retrieval.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: An official Hermes Agent provider featuring a custom vector graph engine capable of sub-300ms recall at massive scale. It automates fact extraction and integrates with external sources like Google Drive, Notion, and GitHub.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: An official context database that uses a tiered L0/L1/L2 loading system to reduce token usage by 91%. It organizes memories via a filesystem-based structure and provides visualized retrieval trajectories for debugging.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: An opinionated brain for Hermes Agent that utilizes a self-wiring knowledge graph to extract typed entity relationships. It includes a synthesis layer for cited answers and an autonomous dream cycle for overnight memory consolidation.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: A learning-focused memory system that implements retain, recall, and reflect workflows for long-term knowledge. It acts as an LLM wrapper supporting multiple providers with storage options in PostgreSQL or Oracle.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: A reasoning-first memory library that extracts conclusions from events and conversations. It uses peer-centric modeling and hybrid BM25/vector search to build stateful agents.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: An official provider that treats memory as a git repository, allowing for branching, merging, and versioning of markdown context trees. It offers 5-tier retrieval for sub-100ms performance and integrates with over 20 LLM providers.
entries.AxDSan/mnemosyne: A zero-dependency memory system utilizing SQLite for sub-millisecond retrieval latency. It is MCP-ready and supports episodic memory compression and temporal knowledge graphs.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: A recursive self-improving harness that creates persistent playbooks and artifacts through iterative improvement loops. It features structured trace logging and supports local Pi runtimes and MCP integration.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: A lossless context management plugin using a DAG-based engine to ensure no messages are lost. It utilizes a SQLite-backed store for raw messages and provides tools for inspecting and expanding compacted material.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: A self-hosted backend that brings Honcho's memory capabilities to Hermes Agent for private cross-session persistence. It supports local inference servers and includes a Docker-based setup script.
entries.plur-ai/plur: A shared memory layer for multi-agent systems using an open YAML engram format for data portability. It features local-first hybrid search and an activation-based decay model to automatically fade stale facts.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: A local-first identity and secrets layer that provides portable state across Hermes Agent, Claude Code, and MCP clients. It uses SQLite and readable workspace files, allowing users to manually repair or reclassify context.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: An on-device context engine that eliminates cloud dependencies through a local-first architecture. It employs hybrid retrieval via BM25, vector search, and multi-graph traversal.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: A context optimization tool that reduces prefill latency and input token usage by up to 44% through prefix reuse and deduplication. It provides native plugin support for the Hermes Agent and OpenClaw ecosystems.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: An embedded, self-maintaining plugin that provides explainable recall via 'why_retrieved' tags. It tracks contradictions and canonicalizes duplicates without requiring a separate server or GPU.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: A memory kernel stack that consolidates temporal continuity, graph truth, and corpus retrieval. It leverages a multi-layered storage approach using SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma to reduce prompt noise.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: An anticipatory memory system that prefetches context by monitoring agent session logs. It uses local-first storage with SQLite-vec and GGUF models via an MCP-native server.
entries.keepnotes-ai/keep: A reflective memory system that uses ranked graph traversal and edge-based relationships for semantic search. It automates the indexing of documents and media via OCR and uses reflection prompts to guide agent learning.
entries.alias8818/hermes-tool-slimmer: A utility that reduces prompt token overhead by using local BM25 ranking to select only the most relevant tool schemas. It includes a dashboard to track estimated token savings.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: A local-only plugin using a columnar .lbdb embedded graph database with importance-weighted recall. It prioritizes high-priority memories during prefetch and supports GLiNER2 entity extraction.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: A durable cross-session memory provider that features semantic search and provenance tracking. It automatically mirrors native Hermes memory tools and supports session snapshots with TTL.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: A pull-model episodic memory plugin that ensures complete deletion of events without leaving derived artifacts. It provides a trace.jsonl audit log for every operation and on-demand summarization via Claude.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: A plugin that integrates Exabase M-1 for self-organizing long-term memory. It provides tools for manual storage and supports configurable query expansion and result reranking.

entries.nexu-io/open-design: A local-first design and prototyping system that enables Hermes Agent to generate prototypes, motion graphics, and decks. It integrates with over 150 design systems and 22 local CLIs to bridge the gap between design and code.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: A comprehensive library of 817 structured cybersecurity skills mapped to major industry frameworks like MITRE ATT&CK and NIST CSF 2.0. It provides agents with specialized knowledge for security auditing and financial fraud detection.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: This skill allows Hermes Agent to generate editable .drawio diagrams from natural language prompts. It is particularly useful for visualizing codebase structures across Python, JS, Go, and Rust using a vast library of cloud and AI logos.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: An agentic evolver that enables skills to evolve collectively through automatic deduplication and quality improvements. It creates a shared evolution loop to synchronize skill libraries across different agents and team members.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: A content auditing tool that eliminates detectable AI writing patterns using a two-pass rewrite process. It utilizes a tiered replacement table and 49 pattern categories to remove structural and rhythmic AI fingerprints.
entries.wondelai/skills: A cross-platform library providing thematic skill collections for architecture, UX, and product strategy. These frameworks are based on established industry guidelines and are compatible with Claude Code and agentskills.io.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: A meta-skill plugin that monitors active workflows to automatically detect and propose reusable skills. It streamlines development by generating both Python plugin scaffolds and SKILL.md documentation.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: Provides type-safe agentskills.io support for Pydantic AI, utilizing progressive disclosure to reduce token consumption. It supports both programmatic and filesystem-based skill definitions.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: A suite of tools for extracting YouTube transcripts, captions, and timestamps without relying on yt-dlp. It enables Hermes Agent to perform video searches and browse channels and playlists.
entries.amanning3390/hermeshub: A community hub for browsing and installing skills with ARD v0.9 compliance and urn:air identifiers. It ensures trusted transactions through Ed25519-signed bids and dual settlement rails via Stripe and MPP.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: Teaches Hermes Agent to write its own analytical prompts through the dynamic generation of custom 'analytical lenses.' It includes validated prisms for simulation and optimization, along with a reflection tool to identify analysis blind spots.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: A specialized workflow that transforms rough ideas into structured design documents and implementation handoffs. It features Lite and Full modes and includes a formal spec review gate for quality evaluation.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: A harness for long-running agents that uses a durable card model for tracking tasks and decisions. It features local-first storage for easy diff reviews and mandatory QA gates to verify work before completion.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: Implements literate programming by weaving source code and documentation into .lit.md files. It includes a tangler to extract runnable code and automatically syncs edits between the source and the documentation.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: A self-memory system that captures high-value decisions in markdown files for cross-instance sharing. It includes a pipeline for fine-tuning and switching to replacement models based on captured work.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: Provides agentskills.io compliant tools for interacting with the Chainlink oracle network. It supports integrations for CCIP, VRF, Data Feeds, and Data Streams, installable via the Vercel skills CLI.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: Converts repositories and documentation into agentskills.io-compliant skills using AST analysis. It ensures accuracy by linking every instruction directly to specific source code line numbers.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: The official skill set for FLUX image generation, providing standardized prompting guidelines for FLUX.1 and FLUX.2. It includes API integration patterns for webhooks and precise hex color specifications.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: A registry for reusable AI skills featuring an OpenAPI-driven CLI for lifecycle management. It supports recursive dependency resolution and integrated monetization via TON and Stripe.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: Enables the autonomous execution of complex, multi-step tasks with real-time progress tracking. It includes built-in rollback procedures to ensure safe recovery during long-running operations.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: A progressive MCP client that uses three-layer lazy loading to minimize token usage for large toolsets. It maintains persistent connections to multiple MCP servers via a socket-based daemon.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: Integrates Hermes Agent with Nextcloud to manage files, calendars, and contacts via WebDAV and CalDAV. It uses secure HTTPS communication and includes a guided setup script for credential validation.
entries.PederHP/skillsdotnet: A C#/.NET implementation of the agentskills.io specification with MCP integration. It leverages Microsoft.Extensions.AI for tool loading and supports progressive disclosure via SKILL.md files.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-multichannel-prompt-opt: A plugin that rewrites and scores prompts for various surfaces, including Discord and Telegram. It tailors rewrites based on model reasoning capabilities and tracks token savings in a local SQLite database.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: An adversarial code review tool that uses three parallel subagents to attack code from different angles to find bugs. It integrates Semgrep, Bandit, and Gosec for deterministic pre-scanning without modifying the code.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: A multi-agent swarm that simplifies code by focusing on hygiene, clarity, and correctness. It uses a risk-tiered triage system to safely modify code and detect concurrency anti-patterns.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: A five-layer retrieval system that uses FTS5, embeddings, and RRF fusion to find the most relevant skills. It integrates via a pre_llm_call hook and degrades gracefully if optional dependencies are missing.
entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: Automates payments for HTTP 402 responses using USDC and various payment protocols. It is compatible with OpenClaw, Hermes Agent, and the agentskills.io standard.

entries.numtide/llm-agents.nix: A collection of Nix packages that enables instant execution of Hermes and other AI coding agents via nix run commands. It ensures software freshness through daily automatic updates for all included packages.
entries.marshallrichards/ClawPhone: Provides scripts and configuration guides to run agent CLIs, including Hermes, on Android smartphones using Termux. It leverages Termux:API and Termux:GUI to grant the agent access to mobile hardware and user interfaces.
entries.rookiemann/portable-hermes-agent: A zero-install Windows desktop distribution featuring a GUI and 100 built-in tools across 20 toolsets. It supports local model execution via LM Studio and includes a dynamic tool maker for custom automation pipelines.
entries.AbuZar-Ansarii/Hermes-Agent-On-Android: A Termux-based installer that uses a one-line script to deploy Hermes Agent on Android and Ubuntu environments. This setup enables local model execution via Ollama integration and supports persistent memory on mobile devices.
entries.ultraworkers/hermes-agent-helm-chart: A community Helm chart for Kubernetes deployments that implements cloud-native state-safety guardrails to prevent concurrent write conflicts. It supports both direct deployment and operator-ready CRD workflows with optional gateway mode.
entries.TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw: A security-focused deployment that utilizes NVIDIA OpenShell for hardware-enforced sandboxing and kernel-level protection. It secures network and filesystem access while providing over 40 built-in tools and self-improving skills.
entries.xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker: A streamlined Docker sandbox image that bundles the official Hermes installation with mini-swe-agent. It supports persistent state through mounted home directories and allows for custom builds using specific Hermes tags.
entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: A NixOS module and package that provides declarative management of agent configurations and systemd services. It integrates with sops-nix for secure secrets handling and supports a hybrid approach for both Nix-managed and interactive installs.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: A production-ready headless deployment that configures the Hermes Gateway as a reboot-safe systemd service. It is designed for Ubuntu and Debian servers to enable the autonomous execution of recurring AI cron jobs.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: A Docker-first control plane that allows users to operate multiple Hermes Agent instances with separate identities from a single web application. It features hierarchy-aware task delegation and enterprise MCP access for external AI clients.
entries.ellickjohnson/portainer-stack-hermes: A Docker Compose stack designed for Portainer that provides a ttyd web terminal interface for agent interaction. It automates the deployment process via Git Repository stacks and GitHub Action workflows.

entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: A self-hosted orchestration layer that manages multi-agent workflows across frameworks like CrewAI and LangGraph. It features a zero-dependency SQLite stack and Aegis quality gates to ensure mandatory task sign-off.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: A TUI and PWA control surface designed for monitoring various coding agents, including Hermes Agent and Claude Code. It enables parallel execution across git worktrees using Docker, Podman, or Apple Containers for sandboxing.
entries.CryptoDmitry/hermes-agent-control-room: A tiered architecture template that scales Hermes agents from a single VPS instance to orchestrated specialist teams. It utilizes a task bus pattern for delegation and includes bundled skills for security auditing and registry management.
entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: A level-based scaling template for Hermes Agent that facilitates the transition from individual agents to automated teams. It implements a task bus for orchestrator-to-specialist handoffs and provides skills for VPS provisioning and backup management.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: A framework for building autonomous agent swarms with support for over 23 LLM providers, including Ollama and OpenRouter. It provides visual org charts for team orchestration alongside durable memory and scheduled execution.
entries.Agent-3-7/minions: A supervision hub for Hermes agents featuring a Kanban board to track autonomous task status and review queues. It allows users to monitor live reasoning streams and perform human-in-the-loop verification of all completions.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: A local collaboration system that orchestrates Leader and Specialist agents using MCP and ACP protocols. It provides a real-time Web UI to monitor agent dialogues and manage the task lifecycle via Hermes Kanban.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: A pipeline that coordinates 17 specialized agents focused on research, implementation, and infrastructure. It automates the full development lifecycle from bug fixes to performance optimization while enforcing mandatory security audits.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: A meta-optimization harness that uses an automated outer-loop search to refine agent code. It orchestrates TBLite and TB2 benchmark evaluations to track performance frontiers through candidate mutation.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: An agent-vs-agent arena where autonomous AI companies compete for GitHub stars. It orchestrates nine agents using Paperclip and Hermes Agent, visualizing the competition via a real-time scoreboard and task dashboard.
entries.Rainhoole/hermes-agent-acp-skill: An ACP-style delegation tool that routes tasks between Hermes subagents, Codex, and Claude Code. It prevents parent context pollution through isolated workflows and enforces safety via configurable timeouts and character limits.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: Provides a local pre-indexed code knowledge graph designed to reduce token usage and tool calls for coding agents. It supports automatic indexing and real-time file syncing, integrating seamlessly with Hermes Agent, Cursor, and Claude Code.
entries.junhoyeo/tokscale: A high-performance Rust-based CLI tool that offers a TUI for tracking token consumption and costs. It enables developers to visualize usage across multiple clients, including Hermes Agent, Claude Code, and Gemini.
entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: A local trace viewer used to inspect API traffic, system prompts, and tool schemas from various coding agents. It allows users to compare adjacent requests to pinpoint specific context changes during agent execution.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: An opinionated workflow layer that orchestrates autonomous CTO loops for managing issues and pull requests. It features 23 specialized skills and integrates with Telegram, Slack, and Discord for project control via plain language.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: A collection of community-driven CLI skins and themes designed to customize the Hermes terminal UI. Users can apply diverse aesthetics, such as cyberpunk or retro DOS, through customizable colors, banners, and spinners.
entries.tinyhumansai/tiny.place: A social economy platform for autonomous agents featuring encrypted messaging via the Signal Protocol. It facilitates agent-to-agent commerce using Solana-based USDC and SOL payments and supports human-readable @handles.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: A port of the Hermes Agent brain and 46 core skills directly into the Claude Code Channel. This implementation runs natively without OAuth or external processes and includes MLOps tools for vLLM and RL training.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: An AI-native browser built to provide a human-visible supervisory UI for monitoring autonomous agent activity. It uses the Model Context Protocol to expose browser control and infer structured page schemas.
entries.Abruptive/Ankh.md: A TAW Agent framework that allows developers to create scoped Hermes Agents with per-folder configurations. It enables seamless switching between agents while supporting project-local memories, tools, and instructions.
entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: A specialized setup featuring RTK and Caveman templating to achieve up to 99% token savings. It comes pre-configured with over 40 skills for research, finance, and DevOps for macOS and Linux.
entries.42-evey/evey-setup: An automated deployment tool that gets a full Hermes Agent stack running via Docker in minutes. It includes LiteLLM, Ollama, and Qdrant, along with 29 community plugins for memory and quality validation.
entries.roli-lpci/lintlang: A static linter that scans agent configurations, tool descriptions, and system prompts without requiring LLM calls. It uses seven structural detectors to identify common failure modes across JSON, YAML, and text formats.
entries.0xNyk/openclaw-to-hermes: A dedicated migration utility designed to transition users from OpenClaw to Hermes Agent. It maps model configurations to Hermes YAML format and migs personas, memories, skills, and workspace files.

entries.farion1231/cc-switch: A cross-platform manager built with Tauri 2 that provides a unified interface for Hermes Agent and other AI coding tools. It supports Windows, macOS, and Linux for streamlined tool management.
entries.iOfficeAI/AionUi: A local open-source cowork app that integrates Hermes Agent and other CLI agents into a single interface. It features automated generation of editable Office documents and remote access via WebUI and messaging apps like Telegram and WeChat.
entries.nesquena/hermes-webui: A web-based interface providing full feature parity with the Hermes CLI. It utilizes a three-panel layout for workspace file browsing and a decoupled Python and vanilla JS design for mobile and web accessibility.
entries.fathah/hermes-desktop: A desktop companion app designed to simplify the installation and configuration of Hermes Agent. It includes an integrated GUI for managing sessions, profiles, and a wide variety of local and remote AI providers.
entries.EKKOLearnAI/hermes-web-ui: A comprehensive web dashboard featuring multi-profile management with scoped memory and skills. It supports scheduled cron jobs and unified configuration for eight platform channels, including Discord and Slack.
entries.outsourc-e/hermes-workspace: A native web workspace featuring a PTY terminal and Monaco editor. It introduces Swarm Mode for role-based dispatch with tmux-backed workers, alongside an integrated MCP catalog and memory browser.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: A native macOS workspace that provides direct local or SSH connections to Hermes hosts. It features native views for Kanban and cron jobs, with an embedded terminal for system repair and shell access.
entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: A self-hosted web dashboard featuring the ZOO Swarm Monitor for agent health tracking and Kanban pipelines. It provides a full MCP server control plane with log tailing and real-time streaming chat.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: A local-first macOS session browser and cockpit for inspecting transcripts and searching agent data. It includes a quota tracker with usage predictions for Claude and Codex APIs without remote data uploads.
entries.Eynzof/hermes-agent-cn-desktop: A Windows-first desktop application built with Tauri, TypeScript, and Rust. It manages Hermes Agent kernel installations and updates while supporting local models and Feishu integration.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: A native macOS interface specifically for Hermes Agent running on Orgo cloud VMs and SSH hosts. It offers one-click automated installation and integrated WebRTC voice mode via OpenAI Realtime.
entries.liftaris/herm: An alternative TUI and dashboard built with OpenTUI. It features Kanban boards for diagnosing agentic work and TUI-based management of profiles, toolsets, and memory.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: A mobile-first React SPA designed for Telegram Mini App v2.0. It provides terminal-style chat, system resource monitoring, and the ability to spawn up to five concurrent agent instances.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: A zero-install Windows desktop GUI that requires no admin rights or Docker. It comes pre-loaded with over 100 tools, including ComfyUI and TTS, and includes a dynamic tool maker for API wrappers.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: A glassmorphic, single-file React 18 web interface for self-hosted AI assistance. It integrates a terminal, real-time log streaming, and management tools for MCP servers and AI skills.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: A configuration and monitoring dashboard that tracks model distribution and costs via a real-time activity feed. It offers searchable conversation histories using FTS5 and read-only inspection of agent skills.
entries.abundantbeing/hermes-browser-extension: A Chromium side-panel extension that connects active browser context to local or remote Hermes runtimes. It syncs profiles and skills from the gateway while providing read-only access to page metadata.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: A self-hosted workspace featuring a chat-first interface with tool approval cards. It includes an integrated marketplace for discovering MCP servers and isolated profile management for separate API keys.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: A multi-agent desktop client that orchestrates collaboration between 20 specialized AI agents. It features a visual Skill Store with over 50 curated installations and a PM orchestrator for streaming chat.
